code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, and thrombocytopenia. There is also a mild elevation of creatinine, suggesting possible renal impairment. The differential white cell count reveals low neutrophils and lymphocytes, with relatively increased basophils. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, infection, or systemic illness. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
